commits.message: fix(docs): review — stale entry/fit comments, section dividers (rich-demos-k78j.t3k)

feat(docs): themes-and-color-studio runs in the card (rich-demos-k78j.t3k)

The 1,250-line app.ts is split by section into files the card shows as
tabs (tour, look, values, themes, transposition, contrast) behind main.ts.
Recording to EXPORT_* needs node/save, so it lives in node.ts, which
npm run themes-and-color-studio runs and the card never reaches. The
tour prints byte-identical to before (EXPORT_TEXT diff).

The card's terminal keeps no scrollback, so card.json gives it the rows
to hold the whole tour, and the width test now also holds the height.

feat(docs): rich-viewport runs in the card (rich-demos-k78j.jdg) (#364)

* feat(docs): rich-viewport runs in the card (rich-demos-k78j.jdg)

One file, main.ts, a WidgetApp on NodeTerminalHost; the entry for the card
and npm run viewport. Revamped: the auto-walking cursor is now driven by the
keys, and the wheel scrolls the window away from it (ensureVisible runs on a
move, not every frame). app.ts/index.ts/wire.ts deleted; the left-edge e2e
reads the card.

* fix(docs): review — staircase guard on a printed demo, viewport TTY check and chords, docs agree with the demo (rich-demos-k78j.jdg)

* docs(viewport): the selection example brings the selection into view on a move, so the wheel can scroll it (rich-demos-k78j.jdg)
